findings.text: an abandoned run whose manifest is recovery-derived and whose session resolves in the pointer, stream or ledger loses its arm-specific advice: the composed "review <manifest> and replace it with a worker-written manifest" (recovery.py:4030-4032) is overwritten by the generic "--advice continue", and no test covers that arm's next_action under a resolved session, so the loss is silent.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; f64e3fa9 adds the reading set and the disposal-arm remedy with two tests (recovery.py:162, recovery.py:4141, recovery.py:4178, tests/test_crew_recover.py:745), and 993e6e37 adds the plan comment, the evidence anchor and one figure, touching no plan meta line.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_crew_recover.py, a temporary config home with the real home asserted untouched, and a base arm; the manifest records the base reproduction (the two added cases failed at 3e6115fb) and the four-file gate, and my independent re-run of tests/test_crew_recover.py at 993e6e37 passed 18 of 18.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that every resumability reader in crew recovery keys on the resolved session; reckon/crew/recovery.py:4141 reads the resolution through RESUMPTION_READING_CLASSIFICATIONS for the stopped and abandoned arms, and no read of the raw session_id field remains anywhere in the head module.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the report store for this node; it states the fix, the two added cases green at head and red at base, the gate at 12 failed/213 passed base against 12 failed/215 passed head with identical failure ids, the ruff deltas, and the declared negative control, and it names its logs on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths (reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_crew_recover.py, the evidence archive, the figures directory, the plan page); git diff 3e6115fb..993e6e37 touches exactly those five paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_crew_recover.py:745 fails when the decision keys on the raw field again (my independent mutation: 1 failed, 1 passed, the verb assertion red at tests/test_crew_recover.py:772), but no test pins the derived-manifest arm's advice, so that half of the change is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded with both arms and identical failure-id sets and my re-run of tests/test_crew_recover.py at 993e6e37 passed 18 of 18, while the abandoned arm's separate base reproduction is disclosed as not run.
justifications.fit: the new set at reckon/crew/recovery.py:162 sits beside ACTIONABLE_RECOVERY_CLASSIFICATIONS with a mechanism comment and the added tests follow the file's existing fixture idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:4141 makes the stopped and abandoned arms consult the resolver and the module holds no raw session_id read, but the new block (recovery.py:4178) overwrites one arm's own composed advice.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 3e6115fb..993e6e37 lies inside the declared write paths, but the same diff changes the abandoned arm's next_action beyond the disposal-advice repair the goal implies (recovery.py:4180 against recovery.py:4032).
